chapters.title: Foundations of Digital Typography
chapters.subtitle: From Lead Movable Type to Dynamic ASTs

epigraph.text: Typography is the craft of endowing human language with a durable visual form.

content.text: Digital typesetting represents the culmination of five centuries of printing tradition. By abstracting prose into structured AST representations, authors maintain semantic clarity while engines handle micro-typographic nuances.
The Grid System and Golden Ratios
Proportional page margins and baseline grids establish a visual rhythm that guides the reader's eye effortlessly across long reading sessions.

content.title: Typesetting Tip
content.text: Optimal line lengths for reading comfort range between 45 and 75 characters per line (10 to 12 words).
A book's interior design should be transparent to the reader, elevating the text without demanding unearned attention.

chapters.title: Multi-Format Compilation Engines
chapters.subtitle: Generating PDF, DOCX, MD, and EPUB in Parallel

content.text: Modern publishing workflows cannot be restricted to a single distribution channel. Writers require high-resolution PDF for print, EPUB for digital readers, and editable DOCX and Markdown for editorial revisions.

content.title: Efficiency Gain
content.text: Single-source compiling reduces formatting divergence across editions to zero.
